attributes.cardDescription: An applicant moving through the hiring pipeline with resume text, skills, interview score, and computed time-to-hire
attributes.readMe:
# Candidate

## Summary
Extends PersonBase with appliedRole, appliedDate, decisionDate, pipeline status (applied | screening | interviewing | offer | hired | rejected), resumeText, skills, overallScore (ScoreField), generatedQuestions, and offer fields. `timeToHire` is a computed DurationField between appliedDate and decisionDate.

## Import
```ts
import { Candidate } from './candidate';
```

## Usage
Paste a resume into `resumeText`, then run the Extract Resume command to fill name/email/skills. The Generate Interview Questions command writes `generatedQuestions`.

## Template Usage
Isolated view shows the pipeline stage, skills pills, generated questions, and the raw resume.
